text_block_list.text:
"Would you like to go fishing with a 
laid-back cat?" Accepting that strange 
invitation, I went along the coast with 
her, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hello there! It's a great day for fishing, 
isn't it, Mr. Angler?♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, welcome, Laurel-san~
choice_data_list: (Could that carefree cat be...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, this spot's for advanced anglers, so 
maybe another fishing spot—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, right here! You might catch a rare 
fish, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look who's motivated. Well then, shall 
we relax and wait for a bite?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the line's pulling! ...Huh? I can't 
reel it in at all...?
choice_data_list: Did your line get snagged?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, looks like you snagged the whole 
Earth. We'd better release it, or we'll be 
in big trouble.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, too bad! And it was bigger than that 
empty can from earlier, too~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Next time, though, I'll definitely catch a 
real fish for you!
choice_data_list:
(Thank goodness. Laurel looks like she's 
having fun.)

(Thank goodness. Laurel looks like she's 
having fun)

text_block_list.text:
It seems the "for experts" label wasn't 
just for show, as Sakura Laurel caught 
zero fish, but—

"Seeing how much they're enjoying fishing, 
they probably won't mind even if they 
don't catch a single thing."
(—*shhhhhh...*)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aw man. I had a feeling the sky looked 
ominous, and sure enough, it started 
raining.
choice_data_list:
F-First, let's go find some shelter from 
the rain...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the sun is in a foul mood~. 
Doesn't seem like it'll stop anytime soon, 
so...
choice_data_list: You're right. Laurel, it's about time...
Yeah. Laurel, it's about time...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... Um, Trainer-san, 
Sky-chan, would you mind taking a break 
right here?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep fishing!
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that asking for a bit much~? Look, 
it's raining this hard...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then it'd be great if there was a way not 
to get wet in the rain. Hmm, wonder if 
there's anything...

"It's just a game, yet to keep trying this 
hard..."
choice_data_list: Did you really love fishing that much?
Did you really love fishing that much?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I am absorbed in it, yes. However, there 
is a reason far more important than that.
choice_data_list: An important reason...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I can't just quit without catching a 
single fish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"We went through so much trouble. If you 
manage to catch one, the sense of 
accomplishment will be that much greater♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So please wait just a moment! I'll look 
for a way to do something about the rain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Mr. Fisherman over there. If 
you don't mind, could we talk—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha, Laurel-san is positive as always.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She's pretty prone to doing that kind of 
thing, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like word puzzles full of brainteasers, or 
tailoring special outfits—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"She's just so positive, always saying, 
'I'll keep trying my best until I can!♪'"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, he has such a refreshing smile, 
yet he won't give an inch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's not just that she hates 
losing— at least, that's what Great 
Detective Sei-chan deduces."
choice_data_list: ...Not just a sore loser, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Looks like we can 
borrow raincoats from a nearby fishing 
tackle shop!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have no intention of dragging 
you trainers into this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I want to keep trying until I 
catch one! ...Is that not okay?”
choice_data_list: Let me stick with you to the very end.

Let's get out of here before it really 
starts pouring.

Let's get out of here before it really 
starts pouring, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I want to keep trying until I 
catch one! ...Is that not okay?”
choice_data_list: Let me stick with you to the very end.

Let's get out of here before it really 
starts pouring.

Let's get out of here before it really 
starts pouring, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thank you very much. I'll definitely 
reel one in!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I've been holding out for quite a 
while, though~ They sure are tough to 
crack.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Laurel-san! Could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Felt good, didn't it! ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! To reel in such a monster fish... 
persistence really does pay off~.
choice_data_list: Impressive as always, Laurel!
Impressive as always, Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, finally. ...Yeah, after all that 
hard work, it really feels amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then we need to come up with a 
plan to catch one quickly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Rainy days can actually be a great 
opportunity, you know? There are fewer 
people around, so places that are usually 
packed are totally empty.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, we might be able to 
find an even better spot to catch fish 
than before... right?♪

"—Afterward, Sakura Laurel and the others' 
plan paid off, and they reeled in a fish 
right away!"
